content.short: Supra is a fast, vertically integrated MultiVM Layer-1 with a suite of powerful native services.
content.description: Supra is a high-performance, vertically integrated MultiVM Layer-1 blockchain designed for speed and scale. It combines native oracle price feeds, onchain randomness, cross-chain communication, and automation inside one stack rather than splitting those services across separate providers. The platform positions itself as infrastructure for developers who want lower-latency execution and built-in data services within a unified environment. For Mantle users, Supra is most relevant as adjacent blockchain infrastructure and an interoperability-connected ecosystem rather than a direct consumer application.
